metadata.methods_description: 32 channels of the left WIMAGINE epidural implant over primary motor and sensory cortex were recorded at about 585 Hz. The implant applied an analog 0.5-300 Hz band-pass and a 292.8 Hz FIR low-pass. The authors then applied a zero-phase 5th-order Butterworth 1-250 Hz band-pass. The seated participant followed on-screen instructions to execute or imagine reaching and wrist-extension movements. EMG of the extensor digitorum and lateral deltoid monitored execution.
